entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7342 of 2025
Applicant :- Farhat Khan @ Fiza
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Malik Meraj Ahmad,Amir Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Shri Malik Meraj Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant, Smt. Kamlesh Kumari, the
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No.115 of 2023 under Sections 406/419/420/467/468/471/120B/34 I.P.C. registered at Police
Station- Kursi, District- Barabanki.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 13.05.2023 against five persons, including the applicant and some other unknown persons, stating that the police had received information that co-accused persons- Abhishek Pratap Singh, Farhat Khan, Neeraj Mishra and others have formed a gang and they were duping people in the name of government employment.
The Police arrested three persons- Abhishek Kumar Singh, Athar Husaain and Neeraj Mishra and recovered providing numerous forged documents from them.
Farhat Khan @ Fiza vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Farhat Khan @ Fiza vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is involved in two other criminal cases in both of which he has been granted bail.

5. Co-accused Abhishek Kumar Singh, Neeraj Singh and Athar Hussain have already been granted bail by this Court and copies of their bail orders have been annexed as Annexure Nos.5, 6 and 7 to the affidavit.
6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail in the aforesaid case.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
Farhat Khan @ Fiza vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
